takeaways.headline: The Raiders backfield is settled.
takeaways.text: Jeanty played 78% of the snaps and got every goal-line carry. That is a workhorse role, and the box score will catch up.

actions.why: Snap share says the role is his; do not sell into a slow box score.

takeaways.headline: Tampa's passing tree just got very short.
takeaways.text: With Godwin out, 71% of the targets went to two players.

usage.read: Workhorse usage, finally. Hold him; the box score will catch up.
The role is real while Godwin is out.

overreactions.take: Bo Nix is a top-5 quarterback now.
overreactions.why: Two of the touchdowns came on broken plays. The volume is real, the efficiency is not yet.
overreactions.price: Ask for a QB1 with a rushing floor

overreactions.take: Jeanty is an RB1 the rest of the way.
overreactions.why: Snap share and schedule both back him.
